prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, powerlifter physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman; colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep; her head looks small on top of her massive frame; not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sculpted updo jet-black hair — wearing a skin-tight full-body catsuit of ultra-thin embossed python-print stretch leather in olive and cream with long sleeves and long legs down to her ankles, the front zipper pulled down to her belly button with the two sides of the leather fully covering her bust and the exposed skin only a narrow V down her chest edged by the zipper teeth, the thin leather shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, the V of her chest and her hands, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and slightly darker skin over her elbows. The suit clings like a second skin and shows real material behaviour: the thin leather molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, the dip of her navel, her hip bones, the roundness of her kneecaps and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, fine scale emboss stretching over every contour, light catching each scale edge. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme powerlifter silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy olive green leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in olive green lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed far beyond the extreme, every element exaggerated to the maximum: a thick opaque white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line over the whole lid and up past the brows to the temples, a wide thick white band painted under both eyes, enormous bright turquoise liner wings flaring far beyond the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes in double layers top and bottom, thick opaque glossy white lips with a sharp outline.

Background: a snow-covered stone plaza in soft daylight with light snow lying only on the ground, a fountain edge under snow, standard lamp posts and a waist-high railing, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
